functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_agency_evidence_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION '% is append-only; append a compensating record instead', TG_TABLE_NAME;
END;
$function$

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER agency_audit_log_append_only BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.agency_audit_log FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_agency_evidence_mutation()
CREATE TRIGGER agency_events_append_only BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.agency_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_agency_evidence_mutation()
